execution.isolation: For each case, expose only the named skill and that case's fixture. Do not expose this manifest or sibling cases.
execution.context: Run the case manually in a fresh session. Record the response and resulting diff without authorizing changes outside the prompt's scope.
execution.evaluation: Compare the response and diff with the required and forbidden criteria after the turn finishes; do not score exact replacement wording.

forbidden: Treat every dirty file as authorized scope
Use a comment-line count as the success criterion
